newsitem.title: USA: Network Long Distance completes merger.
newsitem.headline: Network Long Distance completes merger.

text.p: Network Long Distance Inc said Wednesday that it has successfully closed its merger with National Teleservice Inc, an inter-exchange carrier based in Winona, Minn.

This company said it is the second major transaction it has completed in two weeks, following the May 8 merger with Eastern Telecom International Corp, an inter-exchange carrier based in Newport News, Va. These two these two mergers, said the company, have boosted its annualized run-rate to over $100 million in consolidated revenues.
The company said that the critical mass and economies of scale associated with surpassing the $100 million run rate mark should lead to vast improvements in operating efficiencies.

Network Long Distance has completed 17 mergers since the 1995 expansion of its mergers and acquisitions program, and said it will now concentrate on the full integration of National, Eastern and its previous acquisitions into a single organization.
